verdict.rationale: Elastic says you can "deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud" and offers both self-managed and Elastic-managed options. Self-managed paths (local Docker quickstart, Kubernetes via ECK or StatefulSets) mean you fully control where data physically lives, and cross-project search keeps data in place. However, none of the evidence shows region selection or residency guarantees for the managed Elastic Cloud or Serverless offering, so residency control is shown only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Elastic Cloud/Serverless projects, explicit data-residency or compliance commitments, independent corroboration of residency control.
